name: 24219 · Big Stone Gap, VA
findings: ZIP 24219 (Big Stone Gap) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24219 (Big Stone Gap) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
